item.name: Camp_Sink
item.description: Camp sink connected to the fresh-water and gray-water systems.
item.readyBeforeUse: Potable water flows into the basin and drains into the gray-water system without leaking.
item.readyForNextPerson: The basin and drain are clear, the water is off, and no water is leaking or pooled around the sink.
item.ifNotReady: Stop using the sink and tell the Dominatrix.
